about: Where the site sends readers off it, kept by the site: each book's PDF on Google Drive (perceptualmechanics@gmail.com's Euphonia folder, shared by link), by the file name publish.json gives it, as its Drive file ID; and each module's Roll20 game, by its book key, as its campaign ID. publish.py overwrites a PDF in place, so its ID holds from release to release; a new book needs its ID added here, and verify-euphonia fails until it is.
